question: Evaluate $\hat{i}\times\hat{j}+\hat{j}\times\hat{k}+\hat{k}\times\hat{i}$.
explanation:
Step 1: Use the cyclic vector-product relations among the standard unit vectors.
Step 2: These relations are $\hat{i}\times\hat{j}=\hat{k}$, $\hat{j}\times\hat{k}=\hat{i}$, and $\hat{k}\times\hat{i}=\hat{j}$.
Step 3: Substitute them into the given expression.
Step 4: The expression becomes $\hat{k}+\hat{i}+\hat{j}$.
Step 5: Rearranging the terms gives $\hat{i}+\hat{j}+\hat{k}$.
Final Answer: $\hat{i}\times\hat{j}+\hat{j}\times\hat{k}+\hat{k}\times\hat{i}=\hat{i}+\hat{j}+\hat{k}$.
